title: Canto 11: Kṛṣṇa's Final Instructions - Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 11
content:
Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 11

Artist: B.K. Mitra

Source: Collection of Gita Press, Gorakhpur

11.2

Title: Nārada visiting: ‘Redar Raini from the Chunar Ragamala’, 1591 Shaykh Hatim (Indian, Hara Dynasty), Chunar, India

Source: Internet, Smithsonian National (Freer) Museum of Asian Art, Sackler Gallery.

11.3

Title: Lord Chaitanya Mahaprabhu

Style: Vintage Hindu image

Source: Internet

11.4

Title: Painting of the ten Vishnu avataras, 19th. century, Jaipur, India

Source: Victoria and Albert Museum

11.5

Title: The first painting suggestive of Nārada is titled "Victory of the Buddha".

Artist: Abanindranath Tagore, Wikipedia

Source: 'Myths of the Hindus and Buddhists', Ballantine Press, Oct. 1913

11.6

Title: The image shows Krishna speaking to Uddhava

Source: Internet

Title: "Buddha as a mendicant”.

Title: "The gambols of ghosts".

Artist: Unknown

Source: Internet

Source: Internet

Title: ‘Princess Damayanthi, sending the Royal Swan as messenger to Nalan'.

Source: Wikimedia Commons Internet

Source: Internet

Source: Internet

Title: The image shows the Universal Form of Lord Viṣṇu.

Title: Painting of the goddess Gāyatrī

Title: Solvyns, Les Hindoūs: II.4.2.  "Purrum-hungse, Penitent”.
